description: Amends Aspen Ridge plan, removing eastern land and buffer.
Adds multi-unit and residential care home sites; rezones FUD.
Neighborhood area decreases; population slightly increases.

chips.text: Approved
Superintendent Martin confirmed schools can accommodate population increase.
Aspen Ridge neighborhood residents affected by plan changes.
Two individuals provided feedback, one raising traffic and parking concerns.
Linear park construction, Link Later, slated to start this year.

description: Rezones 702 and 706 Victoria Avenue for high-density.
Permits a six-story, 33-37 unit condominium building.
Zoning agreement controls height and specific design features.

chips.text: Approved
Administration clarified short-term rentals require inclusion in zoning agreement.
Residents seeking bespoke, lock-and-leave condominium housing.
Public raised concerns about traffic, lane use, and construction impacts.
Project includes a green roof and protects mature boulevard trees.

speakers.name: James Peirce
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: 702 and 706 Victoria Ave
said: The proposed six-story building will be a prominent, high-quality residential condominium.
Shadow studies show no significant impact from the proposed increased height.
The design features active frontage, a green roof, and usable balconies.

description: Allows four units on 50-foot sites with two garden/garage suites.
Removes height limits for garden/garage suites with rear lane access.
Permits six units on corner lots in Transit Development Area.

chips.text: Approved
Administration wants City Council review for six-unit corner lot developments.
Secondary suites and garden suites progressed from discretionary to permitted use.
Public comments raised concerns about traffic, parking, and servicing.
Zoning bylaw regulations will be simplified for clarity.

description: Municipal Planning Commission members can attend 2026 planning conferences.
A $7,000 budget is available for educational opportunities.

chips.text: Approved
$7,000 for educational opportunities
A member offered to cover their own flight costs to free up budget.
New Commission members are encouraged to attend conferences.
Interest in a more involved 'A way' conference was not fully explored.
